chapter.title: Act III: The Harvest Debt
subtitle: Autumn, Year One
Fill the granary, open the cellar, set the long table for twelve.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

hover: Four marked beds behind the inn
The first full oven since Josie
Sixteen crystals, four years on a shelf
It finished turning some time in the night

quests.title: Take Oda's Token to the Store Counter
quests.subtitle: She counts the whole town's stores out loud.
description: Oda: "Nine people, a hundred and twelve days to the end of March, and grain for eighty-one of them. That is thirty-one days of nothing."
Take her token to the counter and stand there while she counts.
The &bwinter checklist&r and the granary blueprint go into your book, and Oda leaves the ledger open.

rewards.command: give @p patchouli:guide_book{'patchouli:book':'patchouli:valley_journal'}
rewards.title: Josie's Journal

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"Twelve alcoves in the granary shell. Twelve drawers. Nobody is going hungry on my arithmetic.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The ledger is open
rewards.description: Next: twelve drawers into the granary's twelve alcoves, and four autumn crops into the marked beds.

quests.title: Fill the Granary's Twelve Alcoves
quests.subtitle: One drawer per alcove, at the Lantern Float.
description: Oda: "Twelve alcoves, twelve drawers. Do not improvise on me."
Craft 12 &aOak Full Drawers&r — six oak planks around a wooden chest — and put one in each marked alcove in the granary at the Lantern Float. Any order is right.
They arrive holding the town's stock, and the Granary Waystone goes up outside. Drawers and ducts: &6Power and Logistics&r.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"The key's brass. My initials are scratched off it and yours are scratched on. Don't lose it.","italic":true}]
advancement grant @a only valley:journal/found_4

rewards.title: Granary stocked
rewards.description: Next: one screen reads all twelve drawers, once the mill has a network of its own.

quests.title: Sow the Four Autumn Crops
quests.subtitle: Marked beds behind the inn.
description: Marnie: "Pumpkin, beetroot, oats and barley. Everything else is finished for the year, love."
Plant 4 &aPumpkin Seeds&r, 4 Beetroot Seeds, 4 Oat Seeds and 4 Barley Seeds in the four marked beds behind the inn. Oat is Bakery's, Barley is Thermal's. Nothing has to sprout and nothing is taken.
The larder crate comes back. What grows in which season: &6Farm and Seasons&r.

rewards.command: give @p patchouli:guide_book{'patchouli:book':'patchouli:valley_journal'}
rewards.title: Josie's Journal
Autumn sown
rewards.description: Next: Halden walks you up to the spring, and Marnie's crate on the counter holds twelve preserves.

quests.title: Fill Three Bottles at the Spring
quests.subtitle: Above the hedge garden, with Halden.
description: Halden: "There's a spring above the hedge garden. Josie used it for the quartz, not the tea."
Follow him up, pour out the 3 &aSpring Water&r bottles he sent you home with in the summer, and fill them there. He tops you up to six.
Spring Water is what grows &bcertus quartz&r, and Josie's jar of sixteen crystals has sat on his shelf for four years.

tasks.title: You are standing at the spring above the hedge garden

rewards.command: /tellraw @p [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"She left the jar with me. I never asked what for. I think I knew.","italic":true}]
/tellraw @p [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"She walked that slope in February in her shirtsleeves and called it good circulation, and snow never sat on it.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Spring Water bottled
rewards.description: Next: plant her sixteen crystals in that water and grow thirty-two.

quests.title: Put Up Twelve Preserves
quests.subtitle: Cookbook pages 3 to 5.
description: Marnie: "Four pies, four jams, four jars of pickles — pages three to five. It's all in the crate by the counter."
Make 4 &aApple Pies&r and 4 Berry Jam Jars, then seal 4 Jars of pickles — the plain glass Jar, not the Bakery one — and bring all twelve to the inn counter.
Sweet berries are out of season, so pick wild ones off taiga bushes. More pots and pans: &6Cooking and Brewing&r.

rewards.command: give @p patchouli:guide_book{'patchouli:book':'patchouli:valley_journal'}
rewards.title: Josie's Journal
Larder stocked
rewards.description: Next: four loaves, two pies and two cakes out of one oven — and Bram wants the duct run to the inn.

quests.title: Bake 4 Bread, 2 Chocolate Pies and 2 Cakes
quests.subtitle: In the inn kitchen, off one heat.
description: Marnie: "Four loaves, two pies, two cakes. Bank the oven right and you'll get the lot out of one heat."

Bake 4 &aBread&r, 2 Chocolate Pies and 2 Cakes in the inn kitchen. Milk and eggs came with the larder crate; cocoa is the one thing this valley does not grow, so it comes off a wandering trader or a jungle pod.
It stocks the inn for the Supper, opens Pip's courier board, and it is half of what lets Halden read the Plate.

rewards.command: /tellraw @p [{"text":"Marnie: ","color":"light_purple"},{"text":"That's the first full oven since Josie. Oda will want it written down, and she can wait until morning.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The oven is full
rewards.description: Next: Pip has three parcels on the counter and is already shouting about them.

quests.title: Run Three of Pip's Parcels
quests.subtitle: Named, sorted and urgent, apparently.
description: Pip: "This one's HENRIETTA, this one's THE BIG ONE, and this one's for Nella so you should probably run."
Fold 3 &aCourier Parcels&r — eight paper around one string each — and hold all three when you hand in. Pip runs them from there, loudly.
You get the courier satchel, and Pip draws you. You are mostly hat.

rewards.title: Three parcels delivered
rewards.description: Next: eight smoked hams on Josie's drying rack in the shed behind the inn.

quests.title: Cure Eight Hams on the Rack
quests.subtitle: The shed behind the inn.
description: Marnie: "Eight on the rack — salt, air and a week. No cleverness required, which is why I like it."
Smoke 8 Ham into &aSmoked Ham&r on the stove in the inn kitchen, hang all eight on Josie's drying rack in the shed, and tick this.
Thirty-two cured meat into the granary. Ninety-one days covered, twenty-one short, and Oda has stopped saying the number out loud.

tasks.title: Eight hams hung on the rack.

rewards.command: /tellraw @p [{"text":"Marnie: ","color":"light_purple"},{"text":"That's meat in February. I have not been able to say that sentence in eleven years.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The larder is closed
rewards.description: Next: the two bare bedrooms upstairs at the inn — bed, rug, lantern and chest on each marked spot.

quests.title: Fit Out the Two Guest Rooms
quests.subtitle: Eight marked spots, four in each room.
description: Marnie: "Two rooms upstairs, both bare: a bed, a rug, a lantern and a chest in each. It's all in the packet."
Eight marked spots, four per room — bed on the wool mat, rug beside it, lantern on the hook, chest at the foot. Any order is right.
Two rooms Marnie can let, and a letter from the first person who wants one. More furniture: &6Home and Town&r.

tasks.title: Bed, rug, lantern and chest on all eight marked spots.

rewards.title: Two rooms to let
rewards.description: Next: Wisp is downstream at the marsh beds — twelve rice panicles, all ripe on the same day.

quests.title: Cut Wisp Twelve Rice Panicles
quests.subtitle: The marked plants downstream.
description: Wisp: "Downstream is many rice and they are ready all on the same day, which is rude of them, but good for us."
Cut 12 &aRice Panicles&r from the marked plants downstream — the whole heads, not the milled rice off Oda's shelf — and hand them to Wisp at the reed village.
Wisp pays in rare marsh seed and the whole frog-village decor set, and the Ribbits start coming up to town.

rewards.title: Marsh harvest in
rewards.description: Next: Nella is on the pier. Eight fillets salted into the granary before the lake turns.

quests.title: Salt Eight Fillets into the Granary
quests.subtitle: Nella is on the pier before the lake turns.
description: Nella: "Eight fillets, salted, straight into the granary drawers. Ice fishing works too, but this is the easy way round."
Catch fish off the pier, cure 8 &aCooked Fish Fillets&r, and put all eight in the granary drawers.
A salt barrel on the pier, and twelve each of bowls, bricks, iron and copper for the long table. Rods and fish: &6Animals and Fishing&r.

rewards.command: /tellraw @p [{"text":"Nella: ","color":"aqua"},{"text":"Eight. Fine. That's the lake settled.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Fish in the granary
rewards.description: Next: the long table in the square — twelve place settings and the centrepiece.

quests.title: Dig Out Tobin's Adit
quests.subtitle: About 90 marked blocks in the hillside.
description: Tobin: "Three cores, all copper-rich, all the same seam. So it isn't a pocket, it's a run. About ninety blocks, give or take."
Take Tobin's 3 core samples to the marked hillside, dig out the adit — roughly 90 marked blocks — and open the Lootr chest at the back.
Josie's &aKettle Plate&r is in that chest. Keep it; Halden reads that hand. Samples, beds and hammers: &6Ores and Mining&r.

tasks.title: Adit cleared and the Lootr chest opened

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"Copper, iron, gold AND silver, all in one run, and I'm going to talk about it for a week.","italic":true}]
title @p times 10 70 20
title @p subtitle {"text": "Forty blocks of rock. Something behind.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
title @p title {"text": "Tobin's Adit", "color": "gold"}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:block.bell.resonate master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: The adit is open
rewards.description: Next: an Induction Smelter at the mill, and the Plate goes to Halden at his cottage.

quests.title: Alloy Sixteen Bronze, Sixteen Electrum
quests.subtitle: Build the Induction Smelter first.
description: Bram: "Two inputs, more back than you put in. Three copper and one tin is four bronze. That's the whole machine."
Build a Thermal &aInduction Smelter&r in the mill workshop and run Tobin's raw ore through it: 12 copper and 4 tin makes the bronze, 8 gold and 8 silver the electrum.
Every other Thermal machine, and both roads to a machine frame: &6Thermal&r.

rewards.title: Alloys running
rewards.description: Next: charge an Energy Cell and duct it to the inn, and lay the rail line from the mill to the square.

quests.title: Run Energy Duct to the Inn
quests.subtitle: Marnie gets a fridge out of it.
description: Bram: "Cell on the wall, duct to the inn, and Marnie gets her fridge. Don't overthink it."
Charge a Thermal &aEnergy Cell&r off your dynamos, then run Energy Duct from the mill until the line ends within 12 blocks of the inn.
The Cell Frame is 12 Scrip on Oda's board. The Fridge, Sink and Milk Jar arrive made, with four Works Power Taps to hang them on the line.

tasks.title: Energy Duct reaches within 12 blocks of the inn.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Bram: ","color":"gray"},{"text":"Fridge works. Told her I was working on it.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The inn has power
rewards.description: Next: certus quartz grows in Halden's spring water — thirty-two crystals.

quests.title: Lay the Line to the Square
quests.subtitle: Mill to square, station included.
description: Bram: "Station at the mill, track to the square, both in the packet. Don't curve it more than you have to."
Place 1 &aTrain Station&r at the mill and lay 64 Track from it to the town square.
The engine and two cars come pre-made, and Oda's wagon can finally reach the store. Shafts, cogs and rails: &6Create&r.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"There is a TRAIN. In the valley. I'm going to need everyone to stop and acknowledge that.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The line is live
rewards.description: Next: Oda's Delivery Crate is already sitting in the station chest. Unload it.

quests.title: Unload Oda's Wagon
quests.subtitle: The crate is in the station chest.
description: Oda: "One crate, forty-one items. I signed for every one of them and I'd like them counted again at this end."
Take the &aDelivery Crate&r out of the station chest in the square and open it at Oda's counter.
Her catalogue opens all the way — decor, seeds, animals, every line paid in Valley Scrip.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"Forty-one of forty-one. That is the first delivery this valley has taken in eleven years. Shop's open properly now.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Oda's shelves fill up
rewards.description: Next: the Furniture, Windows and Garden pages go up for Scrip at Oda's Counter.

quests.title: Grow Thirty-Two Certus in Spring Water
quests.subtitle: Josie's jar starts the first batch.
description: Halden: "She kept that jar on my shelf for four years and told me I'd know when. I know when."
Plant Certus Quartz Seeds in his &aSpring Water&r and grow 32 Certus Quartz Crystals. Josie's sixteen seed the first batch; four Growth Accelerators make every batch after it overnight work.
His compass leads to a sky-stone meteorite, and the four presses are in the chest inside. The whole system: &6Storage Network&r.

rewards.command: /tellraw @p [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"The compass is already pointing. She set it. I only carried it.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: Certus growing
rewards.description: Next: an ME Drive, two storage cells and a terminal in the mill workshop.

quests.title: Build the First ME Terminal
quests.subtitle: Drive, two cells, terminal — mill workshop.
description: Bram: "One box that knows what's in every other box. I don't like it and I'm going to use it constantly."
Build 1 &aME Drive&r, 2 Item Storage Cells (4k) and 1 ME Terminal, and set them up in the mill workshop.
Four more cells and the full bus set come back. The granary is twelve drawers and one screen away.

rewards.title: The network is up
rewards.description: Next: storage-bus the granary's twelve drawers onto it.

quests.title: Bus the Granary onto the Network
quests.subtitle: Twelve drawers on one screen.
description: Oda: "If I can see all twelve drawers from the counter, I'll stop walking down there four times a day. Do it."
Put a Storage Bus on the granary's drawer controller, link it to the mill network, and hold a &aWireless Terminal&r. It reads nothing until an &bME Wireless Access Point&r is on the mill wall.
Two terminals come back — one for you, one for your partner — and Oda's ledger updates itself from here on.

tasks.title: The granary's drawers read on the terminal.

rewards.command: give @p patchouli:guide_book{'patchouli:book':'patchouli:valley_journal'}
rewards.title: Josie's Journal
One screen, whole town
rewards.description: Next: a Delivery Crate beside Oda's bounty board, fed by an export bus.

quests.title: Stand Up the Order Board
quests.subtitle: Export bus pointed at a crate by the board.
description: Oda: "Standing orders: bread, planks, nails, lamp oil. If the crate's full when somebody walks up, nobody waits on me."
Place a &aDelivery Crate&r beside Oda's bounty board in the square and point an ME Export Bus at it with the town's standing orders patterned in.
From here on the crate is already full when somebody walks up to it, including you.

tasks.title: Crate beside the board, export bus feeding it.

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"The crate fills itself. I have opinions about that, and all of them are good.","italic":true}]
title @p times 10 70 20
title @p subtitle {"text": "Eleven years of ledger, one full crate.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
title @p title {"text": "Oda's Order Board", "color": "gold"}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Standing orders live
rewards.description: Next: Pip's five winter parcels come out of that crate, in the cold snap.

quests.title: Take the Plate to Halden
quests.subtitle: He can read Josie's shorthand.
description: Halden: "I have been able to read that hand for four years. I have been finding reasons not to. Give it here before I find another one."
Bring the &aKettle Plate&r from the adit to Halden at his cottage and put it in his hands.
The iron door in your cellar turns a quarter and stops. Journal Part Two opens and the reactor recipes appear — the casings still want Josie's Turbine Notes.

rewards.command: /valley scene q54
give @p patchouli:guide_book{'patchouli:book':'patchouli:valley_journal'}
rewards.title: Josie's Journal

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Halden: ","color":"green"},{"text":"It's a parts list. It has always been a parts list. She wasn't digging a mine.","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The door turns a quarter
rewards.description: Next: go down the cellar stairs under the farmhouse and read the wall.

quests.title: Read the Cellar Wall
quests.subtitle: Down the stairs. The door is standing open.
description: Halden, from the top of the stairs: "I carried the chalk up for her and went home. I'm not reading the bottom half over your shoulder."
Go back down the stairs under the farmhouse. The door finished turning some time in the night. Stand in the cellar and read the whole wall, every line, to the bottom.
Her chalk copies itself into the journal, the cellar waystone is yours, and the &aWorks Pick&r is in the chest by the stairs with her blueprint.

tasks.title: You are standing in the cellar, in front of the wall.

rewards.command: give @p minecraft:diamond_pickaxe{Enchantments:[{id:"minecraft:efficiency",lvl:5},{id:"minecraft:unbreaking",lvl:3}],display:{Name:'{"text":"The Works Pick","italic":false,"color":"gold"}'}} 1
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Josie, on the wall: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"If there's more than one set of footprints on these stairs, I was right to wait. Go and turn it on.","italic":true}]
advancement grant @a only valley:journal/cellar_wall
title @p times 10 70 20
title @p subtitle {"text": "She waited for two of you.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
title @p title {"text": "The Cellar Wall", "color": "gold"}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:block.bell.resonate master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: She Built a Power Plant
rewards.description: Next: the long table in the square. Tobin is at the collapsed adit with a shovel and a theory about where the Works opens.

quests.title: Set the Long Table for Twelve
quests.subtitle: Act III finale — the Harvest Supper.
description: Marnie: "Twelve places: nobody stands, nobody eats in the kitchen, and nobody eats alone. That's the rule tonight."
Place the Long Table in the square, one &aPlace Setting&r on each of the twelve marked spots, and the Candle Holder in the middle. A setting is a bowl, an iron ingot, a brick and a copper ingot.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.
Sit down. Three chairs are empty because Marnie set for the year we mean to have.

tasks.title: Twelve settings down and the centrepiece in the middle.

rewards.command: /valley finale act3

rewards.title: The Harvest Supper
rewards.description: Next: sleep one night, then follow Pip down to the inn. Winter starts in the morning.
